song.title: Girls Just Want To Have Fun

guitar.evidence: Cyndi Lauper is a vocalist; her hits were backed by session/touring guitarists with no single famous guitarist or instrument tied to her image.

tone.target: bright 80s pop-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright 80s pop-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A bright, crunchy signal chain using a US Deluxe/AC30 style amp paired with Chorus and light delay to capture the 80s pop sheen.

rig.name: Cyndi Lauper - Girls Just Want To Have Fun - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight pop attack.
Provide a slight lift and punch for the pop-rock crunch.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD to maintain maximum clarity and brightness.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the bright clean-crunch required for pop-rock without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: Red Haze provides a versatile, slightly crunchy tone suitable for 80s pop.

blocks.purpose: Wah is not required and should be bypassed to maintain clarity.

blocks.purpose: Provide the essential 'chorus sheen' and 80s pop texture.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused sound suitable for pop-rock and single-coil pickups.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is ideal for capturing the required clarity and sparkle.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle 'slapback hint' without muddying the pop clarity.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and dimension without sounding overly wet or dark.
